items.title: Jabari Walker getting some extra work in with assistant Phil Handy following shootaround. Joel Embiid is questionable to play tonight vs. Toronto, and Adem Bona (and Dom Barlow…and Ariel Hukporti…) remain out.

quote.author: Gina Mizell
quote.text:
Jabari Walker knows he is doing his job when he starts to hear “little slick comments” like this during a game: 

“Man, stop crashing.” 

“I can’t box you out.” 

The Sixers’ depleted frontcourt needs all the help it can get right now.

media.title: Jabari Walker keeping Sixers’ backup center group afloat and making ‘impactful plays’ for star-studded roster
media.description: Walker, a terrific rebounder despite his 6-foot-7 frame, is filling in as the Sixers' backup center while Adem Bona, Dominick Barlow, and Ariel Hukporti are all sidelined.
